description: This file is a header file defining validation and checking functions for C11 Annex K, including wrapper functions for memory operations, string error handling, environment retrieval, and debugging utilities. It also includes macros for assertions and various type definitions and macros for cross-platform compatibility.

methods.name: ck_getenv_s
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable value with size constraints, storing the size and value in provided pointers.

methods.name: ck_memclear_s
methods.description: Clears memory by setting it to zero with safety checks.

methods.name: errno_t ck_memzero(void * s,rsize_t n)
methods.description: Convenience wrapper around ck_memclear_s to set memory to zero.

methods.name: ck_strerror_s
methods.description: Converts an error number into a human-readable error message.

methods.name: ck_memeq_const_time
methods.description: Performs a constant-time comparison of two memory regions of different lengths.

methods.name: ck_memeq_const_time_fixed_len
methods.description: Performs a constant-time comparison of two memory regions of fixed length.

methods.name: ck_malloc
methods.description: Allocates memory and aborts if allocation fails.

methods.name: ck_calloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory and aborts if allocation fails.

methods.name: ck_realloc_u32
methods.description: Reallocates a list of 32-bit elements with safety checks.

methods.name: ck_bt
methods.description: Prints a backtrace to stderr with a message.

methods.name: ck_bt_abort
methods.description: Prints a backtrace and aborts execution.

methods.name: ck_assert_failed
methods.description: Handles a failed assertion, printing message and aborting.
